callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Akhmet. Big Big, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Elena Kim. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Darius Marsh. From Ashford." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Mateo. The Callback, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Oscar Tanaka will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Ines Baker and Tariq Reyes will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield REFUSES. they do not trust this coalition with their people. (trust −8 — refusals are remembered.)

🛡️ Furaha, Raj step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Furaha, Raj march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 5 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
Packed: 1 Aid from Stonebridge, 2 Foraged food, 3 Foraged food, 4 Tribute grain from Emberhold. (5.0 Mcal, 0.6 kg)
